title: Periodic inspection.
officialText:
The registered design professional or designated inspector shall periodically inspect and observe the
alternative engineered design to determine that the installation is in accordance with the approved construction documents. All
discrepancies shall be brought to the immediate attention of the plumbing contractor for correction. Records shall be kept of all
inspections.
